text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Once again, I severed the chains of fate 
and seized victory. If paradise exists, it 
is right here! The Goddess of Fortune? 
She's crying right beside the Goddess of 
History.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Destruction serves only to create. To defy 
reason, a new myth is required. Come, wipe 
your tears—and share this celebratory 
toast with me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
For the future someone dreamed of, and 
that everyone dreams of. —Cheers!
